brand.description: Action fill, active indicators, progress fill

on-brand.description: Text and icons on brand fill

danger.description: Error. Fills and rules in both themes; text and border roles use danger-ink on light (spec 2.3)

warn.description: Warning. Fills and rules in both themes; text and border roles use warn-ink on light (spec 2.3)

bg.description: App background beneath the light field

ink2.description: Secondary text, labels, captions. Never apply opacity multipliers (spec 2.5)

ink3.description: Non-text only: chevrons, dividers, disabled. Light value deliberately raised from #8A929E to clear 3:1. Never apply opacity multipliers (spec 2.5)

ink-muted.description: Tertiary text: placeholders, ticket IDs, timestamps

accent-ink.description: Accent text only. Brand #C8FF00 must never set type on light (spec 2.4)

glass-fill.description: Panel fill. Light is deliberately more opaque than dark; do not correct (spec 6)

icon-bg.description: Icon wells. NOT progress tracks — see track-solid (spec 6.3)

track-solid.description: Opaque track behind disputable numbers: KPI ring, KRA bars, leave balance bars (spec 6.3 — a number a person may dispute with their manager must not be read through a moving tint). Values are the exact composite of icon-bg over glass, so the appearance is unchanged; being solid, it no longer shifts with what sits behind it

scrim.description: Modal and action-sheet backdrop (spec 10.3 #25, #26). Not in the spec's token table: CustomIonModal's focus-trap workaround hand-builds its backdrop, so a scrim value is required and the mockup never showed one

glass-fill-fallback.description: Solid panel fill where backdrop-filter is unsupported (spec 6.1) and in reduce-transparency mode (spec 6.2). Layout must not change

danger-ink.description: Error text and border. Light measured 4.54

warn-ink.description: Warning text and border. Light measured 4.73

leave-ink.description: Leave text and border. Light measured 4.55 on the violet-26% tint

success-ink.description: Success text and border. Light measured 4.60 on the teal-20% tint

action.description: Primary action shadow (spec 10.1 #1). Glow rides --g-brand-rgb so a brand change propagates

screen-gutter.description: Left/right padding of all screen content

stack-sm.description: Between sibling cards in a grid

sheet-pad-bottom.description: Bottom padding inside a sheet, ADDED to the safe-area inset. Single-value on purpose: pad-panel is two-value ('14px 13px'), so max(var(--g-pad-panel), env(...)) was invalid CSS, the declaration was dropped, and every sheet's primary button sat flush against the viewport floor

blob-a-color.description: Blob A gradient colour, transparent at 70% (spec 3)

blob-a-top.description: Blob A top offset. Geometry is a token so the §3.3 placement check reads the same source the CSS does. Vertical is unconstrained by §3.3: the content column is horizontal and spans the full page height, so once the centre clears it on x the worst case is fixed regardless of y

blob-a-left.description: Box ORIGIN, not centre — §3.3 constrains the centre (origin + size/2). Corrected in v1.4: the v1.1 value put the centre inside the content column. Clearance is measured to the gradient reach, not an arbitrary margin — centre x=-65, 80px clear of the column

blob-b-color.description: Blob B gradient colour, transparent at 70% (spec 3)

blob-b-bottom.description: Blob B bottom offset. Geometry is a token so the §3.3 placement check reads the same source the CSS does. Vertical is unconstrained by §3.3: the content column is horizontal and spans the full page height, so once the centre clears it on x the worst case is fixed regardless of y

blob-b-right.description: Box ORIGIN, not centre — §3.3 constrains the centre (origin + size/2). Corrected in v1.4: the v1.1 value put the centre inside the content column. Clearance is measured to the gradient reach, not an arbitrary margin — centre x=448, 73px clear of the column

blob-c-color.description: Blob C gradient colour, transparent at 70% (spec 3)

blob-c-bottom.description: Blob C bottom offset. Geometry is a token so the §3.3 placement check reads the same source the CSS does. Vertical is unconstrained by §3.3: the content column is horizontal and spans the full page height, so once the centre clears it on x the worst case is fixed regardless of y

blob-c-left.description: Box ORIGIN, not centre — §3.3 constrains the centre (origin + size/2). Corrected in v1.4: the v1.1 value put the centre inside the content column. Clearance is measured to the gradient reach, not an arbitrary margin — centre x=-47, 62px clear of the column

display.description: Display stack. Do not bundle SF Pro

row-label.description: Row label, e.g. Apply for leave

eyebrow.description: Eyebrow, e.g. H1 2026 REVIEW. No opacity multipliers (spec 2.5)

row-tap.description: Row tap: background transitions to icon-bg

theme-change.description: Theme change. Apply to a wrapper, not every node (spec 8)

skeleton-shimmer.description: Skeleton shimmer. Becomes a static fill under prefers-reduced-motion

overlay.description: Dialogs and action sheets. NOTE: sticky is numerically above this, so a sticky header currently paints over an open dialog. Preserved as-is in phase 3 — the values are promoted, not re-ordered; re-ordering is a behaviour change and needs its own review

scrim.description: The hand-built modal backdrop (GModal), which must sit above everything including a sticky header

content-column.description: Content column width. Was authored as '100% - 30px', which is not a valid CSS value on its own; wrapped in calc() so the layout group can be emitted

content-column-lg.description: Desktop content column at lg: (spec 20.3). A starting value, expected to be tuned once on device — which is why the spec insists it be a single token

sheet-max-height.description: Bottom-sheet ceiling (spec 10.3 #25). GModal owns this shape; the token exists so the CSS layer and the Tailwind max-h-sheet utility read the same value

tabbar-gap.description: Gap beneath the tab bar, above the safe area. The tab bar never scrolls

touch-target-min.description: Minimum touch target. Tappable area padded out to 44px without moving the visual

tabbar-height.description: Height of the floating tab bar. Set EXPLICITLY on the bar and reused as the bottom scroll padding of any page inside ion-tabs (8.3). Intrinsic height measured 58px; pinning it means the bar and the space reserved for it cannot drift apart and re-hide content behind it
